title: I am GOLEM! (Discontinued)
description: A simple datapack to allow the user to become a snow golem!
body:
# Mod Discontinued!

Please note that you need to enable commands in the world creation for this datapack to function properly!
This mod is not multiplayer compatible. Use only in single player!

# Current Bugs
- Boats do not work, you still get damaged
- Enchantments are not appearing.
- water proof enchantment not working
# What to expect?
- water proof enchantment to be removed
- boats to be fixed
- enchantments appearing in enchanting tables.
# Description
I am GOLEM! is a datapack which allows the user to play as a snow golem! this definetely has its challenges considering you have less health, but also some better things like your infinite supply of SNOW!

# Installation
Installing this may be kind of different, so heres a tutorial.
- Step 1: Download file
- Step 2: Delete the "pack.mcmeta" file inside of the zip file. NOT THE FOLDER!
- Step 3: Unzip the file into a normal folder, or just leave the "I am Golem" folder, but not the zipped file.
- Step 4: Put the file on your desktop home
- Step 5: Go to create world, and in the settings go to "more" then "datapacks" then open the datapack folders and drag the folder into the datapacks folder from your desktop home.
- Step 6: Just enable commands for the world
- Finished!
- I will make a video tutorial soon!

# --Full list of changes--
- You have 2 hearts (Same as snow golem)
- Your first hotbar slot is dedicated to infinite snowballs. you can still use this slot, however if you want infinite snowballs you should keep this slot empty.
- You leave a snow trail wherever you go.
- You burn in hot biomes: Desert, nether, etc.
- Water hurts you
- Enchantment called "Super Cooled" apply to chestplates for immunity to burning in hot environments
- Enchantment called "Water proof" for leggings protects from water damage.
# Why?
Why did i make this?
As a beginner to datapack making I wanted to make something not entirely super crazy, yet fun! I wanted to just make something I could accomplish without too much struggle and overall just mess around, also thought it would be interesting to make something challenging. I was originally going to make it an iron golem instead of snow golem but i figured I wanted a challenge and something more unique, I didn't think it would be the most challenging to be slightly bigger for a trade off of being super strong and extra health.
